text.content:
Everything you need during play. The chapters have the details.

The roll

Roll 5 dice; each 5 or 6 is a hit. At most +2 bonus dice. Damage = hits + bonuses (only with at least one hit). Guard met (hits at least the Guard): clean. Fewer hits: it hits you back: lose its Harm, gain 1 Chi (unless you went Down). Critical: Guard met and two or more 6s: +1 damage, +1 Chi. A Strike that destroys the enemy can’t be hit back.

A round

1. Wellspring and Harmony share out. 2. Fighters act, any order. 3. Enemies: the Warden or Heart regains 1 Toughness per standing Still; packs Swarm (never on a Down fighter); the Warden or Heart Surges. 4. Awakenings count down; check the clocks; the group may withdraw from an Anchor.

On your turn

One action: Strike, or Rally a Down fighter (up with 2 Vigour and back in play; acts next round). Free (rub the Chi off your sheet as you spend it): Chi die (1 Chi, +1 die, one per roll), Help (1 Chi, +1 die to another’s roll; each helper once per roll), your technique (1 Chi, with a Strike). No movement: Strike any enemy.

Feeding

Ring: Wood → Fire → Earth → Metal → Water → Wood, skipping missing elements. If the action just before yours in this fight was taken by the fighter before you in the ring: +1 damage (if you hit). A Down fighter keeps their place but takes no actions.

A Strike, in order

Declare technique and bonus dice; roll; reroll (Tide, then Lucky); count hits; damage (and Sweeper); Renewal; hit back (and Counter); Critical Chi.

Losing Vigour

Guardian may take it once per round, if they have more Vigour than the loss (+2 Chi if they lose 2 or more); then Bulwark; then Flow; then Unbreakable. Never above your maximum. At 0: Down: lose all Chi, Awakening ends, and you are out of play until a Rally, a Wellspring share or the end of the fight stands you up (no actions, Help, losses, Chi or powers; nobody can choose you for anything else). After the fight: stand with 1 Vigour.

Shells

A Warden’s Guard is 3 until its Shell shatters, but 2 for the element that shatters it. That element’s first hit shatters it; so does half Toughness (rounded down). Sweeper’s damage isn’t a hit.

Techniques (1 Chi)

Wood: after the roll, you or a standing ally +1 Vigour. Fire: +2 damage if you hit. Earth: a fighter’s next loss this round is 3 less (one Bulwark per fighter at a time). Metal: each 6 is three hits. Water: reroll up to three dice that aren’t hits.

Chi

Start 2, max 5. Gain: 1 when hit back (even if a Guardian takes it); 1 on a Critical; 3 for everyone when the Heart fight begins. Spend: Chi die, Help, technique (1); Awaken (3).

Awakening

Once a night, start of your turn, 3 Chi. Open once someone has gone Down tonight, or at the Heart. Lasts 3 rounds counting this one (Seal 2); ends if you go Down or the fight ends.

The night

First Clash: 2 Stills per fighter, no Hour. Hunt, 4 Hours: each Hour, an Anchor (Warden + 1 Still per fighter) or a Respite (full Vigour). Long fight (past round 4, even if you withdraw): costs 1 more Hour (if none are left, the Hour is owed: dawn after round 6). Anchor fights and the First Clash end after round 7. Withdraw from an Anchor at the end of any round. Heart (after the four Hours): +3 Chi each, no withdrawing, dawn after round 7.

Endings

Win: the Heart falls. Driven off: dawn with the Heart at half or less. Loss: everyone Down at the Heart, or dawn with the Heart above half.
